scope: Full resident 3D LBVH build and broad-phase query with native stable radix passes
preconditions: Finite validated collider geometry and interleaved poses; fixed live counts and batch-major scratch capacities
Host-provided identity indices and live counts are upload bookkeeping; all Morton generation, sorting, construction, refitting and pair physics execute on target kernels
Empty-input frontier lengths start at zero; native unsigned-count build/leaf/traversal preconditions are guarded
invariants: Integer topology, Morton keys, counters, copied words, read-only inputs and untouched capacity storage remain exact
Tree graph covers each sorted leaf exactly once, parent links and ranges agree, and escape links implement depth-first traversal
Leaf AABBs enclose independent shape support; completed internal bounds equal child unions and maximum leaf extent
Frontier order and pair allocation order may differ, but legal membership, uniqueness, total requested counts and capacity guards are exact
CPU executes cooperative phases in order; Metal explicitly fences device and threadgroup memory between refit levels
Morton clamp is evaluated after exact power-of-two scaling to preserve the native value without the compiler truncating its fractional endpoint
Ascend stores eight candidate pairs privately per thread; scan and publication still use uniform workgroup barriers. The generated source must contain the private pair array.
No intermediate CPU sorting, tree construction, geometry or pair substitution
Independent stable integer radix specification validates every sort scratch result and untouched word
Final tree independently encloses all leaves; complete filtered overlap set and exact requested pair total are checked even under overflow
outside_scope: Production rigid-body frame integration, dynamic capacity resize/retry and performance qualification
Ascend vendor compilation, device execution and synchronization qualification
tolerance_reason: Leaf world-bound arithmetic and unions propagated from it use existing 2e-6 absolute / 2e-5 relative. Every tree child union is exact within its own result; all keys, ordering, identities, topology, counters, copied words and guards stay exact.
